name: IntentKit
description: Runs a self-hosted cluster of collaborating AI agents that chat on Telegram, Slack, and Lark, act on schedules, and expose per-agent APIs, for teams wanting cloud-native agents.

skills.name: Multi-Agent Collaboration
skills.description: Lets agents in the cluster invoke each other so several agents can split and hand off work as a team.

skills.name: Scheduled Autonomous Tasks
skills.description: Runs agent tasks autonomously on a schedule through a dedicated autonomous runner and scheduler service.

skills.name: Chat Channel Integrations
skills.description: Connects agents to users through built-in Telegram, Slack, and Lark channel adapters.

skills.name: Per-Agent API
skills.description: Exposes each agent through built-in HTTP endpoints, with optional SSE streaming of chat responses.
